transcript.text: my oven fan keeps going after ive turned the oven off, been about 20 mins now. is it broken??

Probably not broken. Most modern ovens have a cooling fan that keeps running after you switch off. It's there to protect the controls, electronics, and surrounding cabinets from heat.

How long is normal?
• Usually 10–30 minutes, but it can be up to an hour if you were cooking at a high temperature, cooking for a long time, or using the pyrolytic/self-clean mode.
• The fan is controlled by temperature, not a timer, so it stops once the oven has cooled enough.

So at 20 minutes, it's very likely just doing its job.

When it might be a problem:
• It's still running after an hour or more, and the oven feels cool inside and out
• It comes on when you haven't used the oven at all
• It's making grinding, rattling, or squealing noises
• There's a burning smell

Any of these could point to a faulty fan thermostat/limit switch, a control board issue, or a worn fan motor.

What to do:
1. Just wait a bit longer and leave the door closed (opening it can confuse things, though it does let heat out).
2. If it's still going well over an hour later and the oven is cold, switch it off at the wall or circuit breaker for a minute and turn it back on. That sometimes resets the controls.
3. If it keeps happening, check your oven's manual (many mention cooling fan run times) or call a technician.

One tip: don't cut the power to stop the fan while the oven is still hot. That fan is protecting the electronics.
